newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake says to sell mill for US$500 mln.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake says to sell mill for US$500 mln.

text.p: Chesapeake Corp said Friday it has signed an agreement to sell its West Point, VA, kraft products mill, four box plants and other assets to St. Laurent Paperboard Inc for about U.S.$500 million.
The company said the deal consists of at least $425 million in cash and up to $75 million of St. Laurent common stock.

The company said that under the terms of the previously announced agreement, it will retain ownership of its timberlands and enter into a 15-year agreement to supply the West Point mill with a substantial portion of its virgin fiber requirements at market prices.
The company said St. Laurent will also enter into a five-year agreement to supply paper at market prices to its packaging operations.
Chesapeake said it expects to record a gain on the sale upon the closing of the deal.
The deal is expected to close in late May, pending regulatory approvals.
